title: Man shot, dies in confrontation with Peel police
article: A 25-year-old man was shot and killed by Peel Regional Police on Sunday after an alleged confrontation in an apartment building in south Mississauga, Ont.
A post-mortem on Gregory Moynagh will be carried out Monday.

The province's Special Investigations Unit, which has taken charge of the case, said the Peel officers arrived at the building on Helene Street North after reports of a man yelling and throwing objects from a fifth-floor balcony.

According to SIU spokesman John Yoannou, "there was a confrontation in the hallway just outside the apartment.... It was in that area that the officers confronted the man and during that confrontation the man was shot. The SIU has recovered two knives from the scene. The part they [the knives] played in this scenario we don't know right now."
Moynagh's relatives said the man had suffered from mental illness.
The SIU is looking for witnesses.
